metais help globs — The patterns that select a package's entries.

A glob selects a package's entries by path. It is matched against the whole
entry path, segment by segment, with / as the separator, and is case-sensitive.

  *       matches any run of characters within one segment.
  ?       matches one character other than /.
  [...]   matches one character in a class; lo-hi is a range.
  [^...]  matches one character not in a class.
  \       makes the next character literal.
  **      standing alone as a segment, matches zero or more whole segments; **
          anywhere else is a usage error.

There are no braces. *, ?, [...] and ** never match a segment that begins with a
dot; a pattern segment that itself begins with a dot matches one. So **/*.md
does not reach into .compiled/, and .compiled/** does. A pattern with no
wildcard that names a directory selects every entry beneath it.
